StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Academic profile and real-time campus status of a FESC student.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

currentZone.description: Current campus zone ID where the student is located.

enrolledSubjects.description: List of active subjects enrolled by the student (max 10).

helpedPeersCount.description: Number of classmates helped in study sessions or SOS alerts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudyTable.title: StudyTable
StudyTable.description: Open collaborative study table on campus with live seat tracking.

userId.description: Owner UID scoping the campus session.

subject.description: Academic subject being studied at the table.

topic.description: Specific exam topic or workshop being reviewed.

campusZone.description: Campus zone identifier (e.g. LIBRARY, CUBICLES, LABS, PLAZA, CAFETERIA).

spotReference.description: Physical table or landmark reference inside the zone.

studyVibe.description: Study dynamic or methodology of the table.

hostName.description: Display name of the student hosting the table.

hostProgram.description: Academic program of the host student.

maxSeats.description: Maximum capacity of the study table (2 to 12).

occupiedSeats.description: Current number of occupied seats (1 to maxSeats).

participantNames.description: Names of students currently seated at the table.

isJoinedByCurrentUser.description: Whether the authenticated student has reserved a seat at this table.

isActive.description: Whether the study table session is currently open.

SosAlert.title: SosAlert
SosAlert.description: Urgent pre-exam academic doubt alert broadcast on campus.

userId.description: Owner UID scoping the campus SOS alert.

subject.description: Subject of the urgent exam question.

questionTitle.description: Short summary of the urgent doubt.

questionDetail.description: Detailed explanation of the exercise or concept needed.

examUrgency.description: Urgency level before the midterm exam.

campusZone.description: Campus zone where the student is waiting for help.

spotReference.description: Exact location reference inside the zone.

authorName.description: Name of the student requesting help.

isResolved.description: Whether the urgent doubt has been resolved.

helperNames.description: List of peer mentors who offered help.

isCurrentUserHelping.description: Whether the current student has joined as a helper/mentor.

responsesCount.description: Number of explanations or replies posted.

CollaborationMessage.title: CollaborationMessage
CollaborationMessage.description: Real-time message or explanation posted inside a StudyTable or SosAlert thread.

parentId.description: ID of the StudyTable or SosAlert this message belongs to.

parentType.description: Whether the parent is a TABLE or SOS alert.

senderName.description: Display name of the message author.

senderRole.description: Academic program or mentor badge of the sender.

isGoingInPerson.description: Whether this message indicates the peer is walking over in person.

/users/{userId}.description: Student academic profile and active campus zone status.

/study_tables/{tableId}.description: Open collaborative study tables across the FESC campus.

/collaboration_messages/{messageId}.description: Coordination messages and explanations for study tables and SOS alerts.
